notes: Gossiping can imply a general character vice.
Official maps to authority; backdoor suggests unfair or improper procedure.
Independent relates to autonomy/freedom from dependence.
Tame suggests control/submission; wild suggests freedom from constraint.
Prestige relates to status; disreputable implies bad moral reputation.
Scandalous/proper invokes propriety, decency, and moral transgression.
Open-mindedness/closed-mindedness relates to tolerance and bias.
